name: National emergency search and rescue
description: Takes requests for search and rescue during storms, floods, landslides, missing persons, and shipwrecks at sea and on land.

name: Fire and Rescue Police
description: Responds to fires, explosions, building collapses, and people trapped at height or underground.

name: Medical emergency
description: Emergency transport for severe injury, cardiac arrest, respiratory arrest, stroke, and life-threatening accidents.

name: Rapid Response Police
description: Protects public order and handles disturbances and theft in disaster evacuation zones.

name: National Child Protection Hotline
description: Emergency support to protect children's rights, safety, and mental health in any situation.

name: National Steering Committee for Disaster Prevention
description: Hotline for disaster reports and national response coordination.

name: Vietnam Red Cross Central Committee
description: Coordinates emergency relief supplies, food, clean water, and support for people in disaster areas.

name: Ministry of Health hotline
description: Advice on disease prevention and treating household water after floods and storms.
